title: Traffic reports: bypass inventory, SSL coverage and flow, Z-Insights client, Log Analyzer, FP/TP Detection Health

detail.method: coverage.py line+branch over the six files, the 32 test files that exercise them (+ the new test file after)

checks.what: Totals equal their parts and every % is 0..100 (detection health, bypass, ssl flow, ssl coverage, log findings), seeded corpora
Oracle table of Z-Insights protocol names; unknown names listed, never folded into SSL or HTTP, kept out of percentages
Insights queries are SDK calls with typed GraphQL variables (zscaler/zins/*.py 1.11.3); unit and window are validated before any query
Window boundaries (15 min, 92 days, 180-day look-back, 5-min future skew), NaN/inf/text/bool
GraphQL errors with data are 'partial', errors fail one section only, messages scrubbed
One query at a time, PACE_SECONDS between queries and none before the first, Stop during the pause; 429 hint
Incident search pages 1..n once each, stops at a short page, dedups, says when cut at MAX_PAGES
gzip, tar and ZIP bombs, member and note caps, nesting depth, traversal names, 10 MB single lines
Seeded byte mutations of every bundle kind end in a result or a plain error
Secrets in evidence and error lines (bearer, JSON, *_token, cookies, provisioning keys)
Insights user rows never exported; detection-health logs carry no names; report errors scrubbed (server patch open)
Verdict oracle, FP/TP in lowest terms, rates and shares within 0..100
No dead-rule proposal from unobserved data; applying a proposal is refused without the write gates before any client is built
Threshold overrides validated; no request-written regular expression
Markdown, CSV, DOCX and XLSX exports of all six reports keep hostile tenant text inert
Bypass report reads nothing out of scope and refuses an empty scope
SSL coverage history written 0600, atomically, no temp file left; damaged history reads as empty
Nothing fetches a URL from an upload or tenant string: PAC evaluation assumes public DNS and never resolves or downloads
An unreadable rule list is 'could not be read', never 'no bypass'
400 seeded malformed incidents, rules, ZCC profiles and Insights answers never stop a report
Client-side Markdown download of the Log Analyzer page

findings.title: Log evidence redaction missed bearer tokens, JSON-quoted keys, prefixed *_token / JSESSIONID / provisioning_key keys and all but the first cookie
findings.fix: Header-aware (Authorization, Cookie) and key-suffix redaction, quoted keys and values, bounded linear patterns

findings.title: A ZIP with thousands of entries past the member cap returned one note per entry (unbounded response)
findings.fix: Stop at the member cap and keep at most MAX_NOTES notes plus a count

findings.title: Detection Health threshold overrides were not validated: a text threshold was a 500 and telemetry_patterns compiled a request-written regular expression
findings.fix: clean_settings: bounded whole numbers, short text lists, plain-text telemetry fragments; invalid values keep the default with a note

findings.title: The not_real override was echoed in the report but verdicts were always taken with the defaults
findings.fix: Verdicts re-derived with the run's not_real list

findings.title: fp/dead/promote windows longer than the incidents read: 7 days of incidents raised 'Disable X: no incident in 30 days'
findings.fix: Each window is clamped to the days read and the report states the windows used

findings.title: An incident read stopped at MAX_PAGES was silent, so counts and dead rules were built on part of the window
findings.fix: Truncation is a read problem and no rule is called dead

findings.title: A Web DLP rule that forwards no match to an Incident Receiver (it can never have an incident) was called dead and given a retire proposal
findings.fix: Such rules are not_measured, with no dead-rule finding or proposal

findings.title: Summary users / destinations counted the '(unknown ...)' placeholder rows
findings.fix: Count distinct known users and destinations only

findings.title: Bypass Markdown export wrote tenant category names, rule names, URLs and keywords raw in the URL Category Expansion Detail (forged heading, link, code-span break-out)
findings.fix: md_safe.text / md_safe.code for every tenant value in that section

findings.title: A boolean advanced setting whose key holds 'bypass' (enableEvaluatePolicyOnGlobalSSLBypass) was counted as an SSL exemption and as a bypassed URL 'False'
findings.fix: Only lists and non-empty texts are exempted values

findings.title: A rule list or advanced settings answering 401/403/5xx was reported as zero bypasses (fail-open reporting)
findings.fix: Unreadable sections are a diagnostic and status unverified; 404 stays 'not on this tenant'; ZCC with no endpoint answering is a diagnostic

findings.title: Bypass rules scoped by SDK conditions (locationGroups, sourceIpGroups, deviceGroups, platforms, timeWindows, ...) were flagged 'applies to everyone'
findings.fix: The scope summary reads every scope field the SDK models carry (as_dict camelCase)

findings.title: SSL flow sort crashed on a rule id or order sent as text or an infinity
findings.fix: _int() with a default for ids and orders

findings.title: SSL flow summary left info gaps out, so high + medium + low did not add up to gaps
findings.fix: Summary counts info gaps

findings.title: SSL coverage counted a boolean protocol total as 1 and did not total the unrecognised protocols apart
findings.fix: Booleans skipped; unrecognised_total added (names still listed, never bucketed)

findings.title: Insights validate_window raised OverflowError (not WindowError) for an infinite bound
findings.fix: OverflowError refused as a WindowError

findings.title: A rate-limited Insights answer (429) had no plain-language hint
findings.fix: Rate-limit hint

findings.title: Log Analyzer kept the first 400 tunnel states, so a long log reported a stale last tunnel state
findings.fix: deque of the latest 400

findings.title: A PAC with a low finding was summed up as 'passes every check'
findings.fix: Low PAC findings give an 'info' verdict

findings.title: Live feed 'since' without a zone was a TypeError (500); one in the future asked an inverted window
findings.fix: Naive is UTC; a future cursor starts now

findings.title: A .gz with a good header and a broken deflate body raised zlib.error out of analyze() (500)
findings.fix: zlib.error is a note

findings.title: A ZIP claiming a future version raised NotImplementedError (500); a lying member offset failed the whole upload with 'negative seek value'
findings.fix: Both are notes for that archive or member; seeded mutation test

findings.title: Malformed tenant data stopped reports: a bare category name read character by character, int() of text match counts, out-of-range createdAt, non-list fields, a list rule id, ZCC shapes
findings.fix: Defensive readers (_names, _whole, _items, _seq/_map); 400-case seeded test

findings.title: Detection Health read problems (SDK error text) went into the report and the live feed with no scrub
findings.fix: generate() and poll_incidents() take a scrub applied to every read problem

findings.title: The /api/detection-health and live-feed routes do not mask the sign-in's secrets in the read problems they return
findings.fix: /api/detection-health and /api/live-feed pass detection_health's scrub hook (tenant_auth.mask_secrets with the sign-in); the report's log lines and proposal error are masked too (test isolation follow-up a730f83)

findings.title: The Log Analyzer page's Markdown download builds from raw upload text: file and PAC names, users, notes and bypass values add headings, links or table cells, and a log line holding ``` closes the evidence fence
findings.fix: report_logs.html escapes every upload-derived value as md_safe.text does and fences evidence longer than any backtick run it holds; tests run the page's own markdown() in Node. Also ...::test_the_log_analyzer_markdown_evidence_fence_cannot_be_closed_by_a_log_line

findings.title: safe_files.zip_member lets ValueError ('negative seek value') and OSError escape for a member whose offset lies, so callers that catch only ArchiveRefused fail
findings.fix: zip_member refuses ValueError and OSError from a lying member offset as ArchiveRefused (ArchiveRefused itself re-raised first)

findings.title: The Bypass report's aggregated 'bypassed' lists and summary include rules whose state is DISABLED
findings.fix: Kept on purpose: the inventory is for auditors, every item carries its rule state, and risk flags already require ENABLED

findings.title: Log Analyzer facts show the device user's e-mail address from the logs
findings.fix: Needed to identify the device; shown on screen only, never logged or written to disk

findings.title: The live feed polls by creation time, so an incident ingested after its window passed is not shown live
findings.fix: Documented limit of a creation-time window; the full report reads the whole period

findings.title: clean_settings (added in this wave) raised OverflowError on an Infinity threshold
findings.fix: math.isfinite check

findings.title: docs/SECURITY_TESTING.md is stale once this branch's 66 mapped tests land (test_security_test_matrix::test_the_standards_document_is_current)
findings.fix: Resolved at integration: docs/SECURITY_TESTING.md was regenerated with python tools/security_test_matrix.py after the merges and is regenerated again on this branch
